It is essential for individuals in helping professions to receive appropriate training and supervision to reduce their risk of vicarious traumatization. Connecting with other professionals who understand the experience of working with trauma can also be beneficial. Furthermore, prioritizing self-care and seeking help when needed can help individuals manage the psychological impact of vicarious trauma and maintain their resilience.
